title: SDR daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04
content:
Morning plan / context:
- Quick focus: top-of-funnel outbound + follow-ups for EMEA accounts. 2 demos booked this week, push to get 2 more SQLs.
- Key message: predictable inference costs + private deployment options for regulated workloads. Mention Dedicated for throughput/SLA.

Priority account list (today):
1) Helix Health - contact: Maya Ortiz (VP Eng) - last touch: 2026-03-02 demo interest - pain: latency & PHI compliance - notes: ask about current hosting, mention Private VPC + KMS integration - next step: send tech brief + propose Tue 10am PT.
2) Finex Labs - contact: Omar Rahman (Head of AI) - last touch: cold email 2026-03-01 - pain: token cost at scale - notes: highlight Redwood Optimize batching + quantization suggestions - next step: call at 10:15am, if no answer leave concise VM + follow-up email with ROI calc.
3) EduWave - contact: Priya Desai (Director Product) - last touch: demo booked 2026-03-05 - pain: latency spikes during peak loads - notes: discuss autoscaling + Dedicated reserved capacity - next step: prep slides for demo, loop SE Jamie for model routing example.
4) CoreFin - contact: Lars Mueller (CTO) - last touch: LinkedIn message 2026-03-03 - pain: audit logs, compliance - notes: highlight audit logs + Private deployment + enterprise support - next step: send compliance one-pager, request 30-min technical intro.

Call script snippets:
- Intro: "Hey [name], Ryan Kim from Redwood Inference — we help teams run LLM inference with predictable latency and cost so engineering teams don't have to babysit deployments."
- Discovery: "What are your main constraints today — latency, cost, or compliance?"
- Value prop short: "You can pick hosted for speed, Dedicated for guaranteed throughput, or Private for regulated data — same API, consistent ops."
- Close ask: "Would you be open to a 30-min technical intro with our solutions engineer to see a quick perf/cost comparison for your workload?"

Follow-up templates (short):
- After VM: "Quick note — left a voicemail about helping with [pain]. Happy to share a short technical brief. When's a good time?"
- Post-demo confirm: "Thanks for the time — attaching notes + next steps. I'll loop SE Jamie for the technical deep-dive on routing and autoscaling."

- Oppty 10012 (Finex Labs): cold->engaged. Need ROI calc to move.
- Oppty 10045 (EduWave): demo scheduled. Prep: scenario-based prompt tests + perf numbers.
